sections.title: Main-conference oral presentations
sections.detail: O1–O7 contain 21 recorded oral presentations. All 21 also appear in the broader secondary catalogue. Canonical paper PDFs and official acceptance records still need direct primary verification.

sections.title: Main-conference spotlight presentations
sections.detail: S1–S5 are indexed from supplied recordings (45 talks). The secondary catalogue includes S6–S8 metadata and all 72 spotlight abstracts. Matching the missing morning sessions to original playback remains open.

sections.title: Accepted main-conference posters
sections.detail: The secondary main-conference snapshot includes 594 poster-only entries with titles, authors, abstracts and original OpenReview links. Acceptance counts and paper content have not yet been independently reconciled with the canonical primary portal.

sections.title: Late-breaking research
sections.detail: Opening remarks identify agentic robotics and real-to-sim-to-real as the two themes and report 39 accepted contributions. Treat these as a separate track with distinct review and publication status.

sections.title: Workshop research
sections.detail: All 32 workshop directory entries were checked against the official program. 484 published paper entries across 15 workshops are indexed; 12 organizer lists are complete. 51 original abstracts are available. Twenty workshops still have unresolved complete paper lists, including a published filename-only folder and selected subsets. Workshop acceptance is distinct from archival main-conference acceptance.

sections.title: Keynotes, industry and discussion
sections.detail: Includes six keynotes, twelve industry/sponsor presentations, a fireside chat, a special debate and the closing session. Industry claims remain speaker-reported unless supported by a reviewed technical source.

sections.title: Full main-conference catalogue snapshot
sections.detail: 21 oral, 72 spotlight and 594 poster-only entries, including abstracts. This is an attributed discovery catalogue; original manuscripts and official decisions remain separate verification steps.

source_policy.research_references: Original papers, technical reports, project pages, code/data releases and original recordings.
source_policy.social_discovery: Social posts can identify work to investigate; posts are not used as supporting research references.
source_policy.primary_source_status: Workshop directory membership and readable organizer lists were reviewed. Some papers have reviewed primary abstracts or indexed primary-paper bodies; others remain title-only entries or reference pointers. Each record states its depth.
source_policy.editorial_edges: Connections and reading questions are this atlas’s synthesis unless a reviewed source explicitly establishes the relationship.
source_policy.catalogue_status: The 687-paper main index comes from an attributed secondary snapshot. It is useful for exhaustive discovery but does not independently establish each official decision or manuscript finding.

access_note: Supported primary-page and indexed-paper readers were used. OpenReview’s browser-verification challenge and PDF access errors prevented direct completion of portal-dependent paper lists and manuscripts; no verification bypass was attempted.
review_note: Focused reviews cover public manuscript sections or author project methods, with exact depth stated per source. This is separate from exhaustive catalogue discovery and independent confirmation of accepted publication versions.
